lines:
flowchart TD
    A[Selected C4 branch] --> B[Collect branch children]
    B --> C[Find immediate incoming and outgoing relationship endpoints]
    C --> D[Include external dependency neighbors]
    D --> E[Rank nodes by dependency direction and containment]
    E --> F[Prioritize key relationships and collapse noisy edges]
    F --> G[Emit deterministic Structurizr view coordinates]
    G --> H[Render readable Dependency View]
    H --> I[Inspector keeps full relationship and source detail]

    C --> J{Endpoint outside selected branch?}
    J -->|Yes| D
    J -->|No| E
